  <bpmn:process id="Process_Player" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_BotRequested" name="Bot creation requested">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectResources" name="Select resources to farm">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_Parallel">
      <bpmn:text>Up to 10 resources can be collected in parallel</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_Parallel" sourceRef="Task_SelectResources" targetRef="Annotation_Parallel"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetUrgency" name="Set resource urgency">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DefineDependencies" name="Define tool dependency logic">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_StartFarming" name="Start farming">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FarmMerge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Gather" name="Gather resources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FarmSplit" name="All resources gathered?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ShareSplit" name="Share results">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ShareJoin">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_BotFinished" name="Bot finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_BotRequested" targetRef="Task_SelectResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_SelectResources" targetRef="Task_SetUrgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_SetUrgency" targetRef="Task_DefineDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_DefineDependencies" targetRef="Task_StartFarming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_StartFarming" targetRef="Gateway_FarmMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Gateway_FarmMerge" targetRef="Task_Gather"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_Gather" targetRef="Gateway_FarmSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_FarmSplit" targetRef="Gateway_FarmMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_FarmSplit" targetRef="Gateway_ShareSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_ShareSplit" targetRef="Task_Brag"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_ShareSplit" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_ShareJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_ShareJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_ShareJoin" targetRef="End_BotFinished"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_UpdateMaterials" name="Update materials list" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_UpdateRequest" name="Materials list update requested" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Update_1</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_UpdateRequest" messageRef="Message_UpdateRequest"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateMaterials" name="Update list of materials to farm">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Update_1</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Update_2</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:userTask>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_UpdateMaterials" name="Materials list updated">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Update_2</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_1" sourceRef="Start_UpdateRequest" targetRef="Task_UpdateMaterials"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_2" sourceRef="Task_UpdateMaterials" targetRef="End_UpdateMaterials"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Disaster" name="Handle natural disaster" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Disaster" name="Natural disaster strikes" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disaster_1</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SED_Disaster" signalRef="Signal_NaturalDisaster"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ApplySetback" name="Apply disaster setback to farming progress">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disaster_1</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disaster_2</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:serviceTask>

        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disaster_2</bpmn:incoming>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_1" sourceRef="Start_Disaster" targetRef="Task_ApplySetback"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_2" sourceRef="Task_ApplySetback" targetRef="End_Disaster"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Milestone" name="Notify on milestone" triggeredByEvent="true">

      </bpmn:endEvent>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_FarmingBot" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_UpdateRequest" name="Materials list update requested"/>
  <bpmn:signal id="Signal_NaturalDisaster" name="Natural disaster strikes"/>
  <bpmn:signal id="Signal_MilestoneReached" name="Milestone reached"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_FarmingBot">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Player" name="Player">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_BotRequested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectResources</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetUrgency</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ShareSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Brag</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ShareJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_BotFinished</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Bot" name="Bot">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StartFarming</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GatherBase</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateTool</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GatherDependent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_UpdateMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Disaster</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Milestone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_BotRequested" name="Bot creation requested">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectResources" name="Select resources">
      <bpmn:documentation>Up to 10 resources can be collected in parallel.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetUrgency" name="Set resource urgency">
      <bpmn:documentation>Some resources are more urgently needed than others.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_StartFarming" name="Start farming">
      <bpmn:documentation>Starts after all preferences are collected.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GatherBase" name="Gather base resources">
      <bpmn:documentation>Gathers the resources that are required to create tools. Up to 10 resources can be collected in parallel.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CreateTool" name="Create tool">
      <bpmn:documentation>Creates the tool needed to gather the dependent resources, using the gathered base resources.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GatherDependent" name="Gather dependent resources">
      <bpmn:documentation>Gathers the resources that require a tool, after the tool has been created.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ShareSplit" name="Share results">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ShareJoin" name="Sharing done">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_BotFinished" name="Bot finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_UpdateMaterials" name="Update materials list" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_UpdateRequest" name="Materials list update requested" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Update_1</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_UpdateRequest" messageRef="Message_UpdateRequest"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateMaterials" name="Update materials list">
        <bpmn:documentation>Can be done at all times during farming.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Update_1</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Update_2</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:userTask>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_UpdateMaterials" name="Materials list updated">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Update_2</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_1" sourceRef="Start_UpdateRequest" targetRef="Task_UpdateMaterials"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Update_2" sourceRef="Task_UpdateMaterials" targetRef="End_UpdateMaterials"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Disaster" name="Handle natural disaster" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Disaster" name="Natural disaster strikes" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disaster_1</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SED_Disaster" signalRef="Signal_NaturalDisaster"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ApplySetback" name="Apply setback">
        <bpmn:documentation>Random natural disasters set the bot back.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disaster_1</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disaster_2</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:serviceTask>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Disaster" name="Bot setback applied">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disaster_2</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_1" sourceRef="Start_Disaster" targetRef="Task_ApplySetback"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_2" sourceRef="Task_ApplySetback" targetRef="End_Disaster"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Milestone" name="Notify on milestone" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Milestone" name="Milestone reached" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Milestone_1</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SED_Milestone" signalRef="Signal_MilestoneReached"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player">
        <bpmn:documentation>Whenever a milestone is reached, the player is notified.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Milestone_1</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Milestone_2</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:serviceTask>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Milestone" name="Player notified">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Milestone_2</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_1" sourceRef="Start_Milestone" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_2" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="End_Milestone"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_BotRequested" targetRef="Task_SelectResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_SelectResources" targetRef="Task_SetUrgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_SetUrgency" targetRef="Task_StartFarming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_StartFarming" targetRef="Task_GatherBase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_GatherBase" targetRef="Task_CreateTool"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_CreateTool" targetRef="Task_GatherDependent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_GatherDependent" targetRef="Gateway_ShareSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Gateway_ShareSplit" targetRef="Task_Brag"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Gateway_ShareSplit" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_ShareJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_ShareJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_ShareJoin" targetRef="End_BotFinished"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
